findings.summary: DefaultHarvestOps.worktree_cherry_pick unconditionally removes the detached worktree in its finally block (harvest_ops.py:137-141), but the following orchestration node run_verify runs 'make verify' against that same worktree path (harvest.py:343-345). The removed directory makes subprocess.run fail (FileNotFoundError -> exit 127), so verify can never exit 0. Per 交付 B.3's postconditions that forces OUTCOME_ESCALATED every run -- the harvest subgraph can never reach HARVESTED, and the 交付 B.2 SOP step '全量套件(make verify)' is executed against a non-existent directory. The default (production) ops path is therefore non-functional, and the worktree cherry-pick/conflict-resolution result is discarded before it can be validated or merged.
